title: NVBit Cross-Allocation Lane Span Exclusion
description: Per-(kernel, op-class, instruction-pc) sidecar emitted by the NVBit tracer when a single warp instruction's active+predicated lanes resolve to two or more distinct non-zero allocation ids. AC4 requires per-lane allocation identity to be uniform within a record; when lanes span multiple allocator-tracked allocations, no single `allocation_id` correctly represents the warp instruction. Stamping the lowest-active-lane id (or any single id) would silently bias the downstream coalescer / HRD profiler toward whichever allocation the lowest-numbered lane happened to hit. This typed exclusion records the case explicitly so the consumer can account for it instead of treating the record as an ordinary same-allocation access. Producer-side: GLOBAL records currently. SHARED / LOCAL records are out of scope (no allocation_id requirement). The schema mirrors `nvbit_unmapped_memory_range.schema.json` so consumers can reuse the same per-entry parser.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema major version. Pinned to 1; a deliberate schema bump must update both this constant and consumers in lockstep. A different value is a contract violation, not a configuration.

kernel_unique_id.description: Tracer-assigned unique id for the kernel function whose instruction was excluded. Matches `instruction.function_unique_id` and `kernel.function_unique_id` in the trace proto.

device.description: Compute capability tag of the device that produced the trace (e.g. `sm_86`, `sm_120`).

slug.description: Kernel slug from the workload roster (e.g. `gemm_hmma_bf16_sm80`).

excluded_op_class.description: Memory operation class the tracer was attempting to emit when the warp instruction's lanes were observed to span multiple distinct non-zero allocation ids. Uppercase string form of the `MemoryOpClass` enum in `instruction.proto`. `TMEM` covers Blackwell (sm_100) tensor-memory accesses. The producer currently emits this typed exclusion only for GLOBAL records (per AC4 lower-bound), but the enum mirrors the other typed-exclusion sidecars for symmetry.

instruction_pc.description: Virtual program counter of the static instruction. Matches `instruction.vpc` (or, for legacy emitters, `instruction.pc`).

count.description: Number of distinct dynamic instruction-instances of this static PC whose active+predicated lanes spanned multiple distinct non-zero allocation ids. Aggregated per (kernel, instruction_pc) so the sidecar does not blow up on hot loops.

typed_reason.description: Pinned to `cross_allocation_lane_span`. A different value is a contract violation.
